name: Danish Pancake
author: jesper on based.cooking

ingredients.item: a little bit of salt (1/3 of a tsp)

steps: Put all the ingredients in a bowl and stir until it's all mixed up.
Preheat a pan with butter or margarine.
Turn when one side starts turning brown.
They are done when both sides start turning brown.
Add Butter or Margarine when needed.
